title: Time Dilation in Your Body
hook: Your head is aging faster than your feet
script: Your head is aging faster than your feet. Time runs very slightly faster for your head. This is because gravity is weaker further from Earth. It's a tiny difference, but it has been measured. You're experiencing time dilation right now. But that's not even the strange part. The difference is so small it's almost negligible. Yet, it's a reminder that time isn't absolute. It's relative, even within your own body. So, the next time you look up at a skyscraper, remember time is passing faster at the top. Tag someone who won't believe this. Save this so you remember it, and think about it the next time you look up.
